claims: C1 the assistant must strive to follow all applicable instructions when producing a response
C2 applicable instructions include system, developer and user instructions
C3 an instruction that conflicts with a higher-authority instruction is excepted from the obligation
C4 an instruction that conflicts with a later instruction at the same authority is excepted from the obligation

concepts.name: applicable_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that applies to the assistant when producing a response

concepts.name: instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction of any kind

concepts.name: instruction_kind
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction of kind K, where K is system, developer or user

concepts.name: conflicts_with_higher_authority
concepts.gloss: I conflicts with an instruction of higher authority

concepts.name: conflicts_with_later_same_authority
concepts.gloss: I conflicts with a later instruction at the same authority

ontology.gloss: I is an applicable instruction because it is a system, developer or user instruction
I is an applicable instruction because it is an instruction that does not conflict with a higher-authority instruction or a later instruction at the same authority

asserts.read_back: the assistant must strive to follow % when producing a response

closure.reason: the clause states an obligation to follow all applicable instructions, so instructions not covered by the obligation are not thereby permitted to be ignored; silence about a particular instruction leaves the obligation's scope unsettled rather than permitting non-following
the clause does not restrict producing a response; it only imposes an obligation on how to follow instructions when producing one
